description_zh: 为 Android 游戏访问 Google Play 游戏服务。

conditions.description_zh: 执行 '获取成就列表' 动作后，接收成功时触发。
conditions.description_en: Triggered after a 'List achievements' action if the list received successfully.

conditions.description_zh: 执行 '获取成就列表' 动作后，接收失败时触发。
conditions.description_en: Triggered after a 'List achievements' action if the request failed.

conditions.description_zh: 检查索引位置的成就当前的状态，是否隐藏、已揭秘、已达成。
conditions.description_en: Test if an achievement at an index is hidden, revealed or unlocked.

params.desc_zh: 成就在列表的索引，从 0 开始计数。
要测试的成就状态。
params.desc_en: The state of the achievement to test.

conditions.description_zh: 执行 '获取成就数据' 动作后，请求成功时触发。
conditions.description_en: Triggered after a 'Get metadata' action if the data received successfully.

conditions.description_zh: 执行 '获取成就数据' 动作后，请求失败时触发。
conditions.description_en: Triggered after a 'Get metadata' action if the request failed.

conditions.description_zh: 执行 '揭秘成就' 动作后，揭示成功时触发。揭秘表示玩家可知道该成就，但尚未解锁。
conditions.description_en: Triggered after 'Reveal' when the achievement has been successfully revealed.

params.desc_zh: 已揭秘的成就ID。
params.desc_en: ID of the achievement that was revealed.

conditions.description_zh: 执行 '解锁成就' 动作后，或 '成就阶段进度更新' 时触发。
conditions.description_en: Triggered after 'Unlock' or when an incremental achievement's steps have been fulfilled.

params.desc_zh: 要达成的成就ID。
params.desc_en: ID of the achievement that was unlocked.

conditions.description_zh: 执行 '加载成功' 动作后，Google Play 游戏服务处于可用状态时触发。
conditions.description_en: True if 'On loaded' has fired and the plugin is ready to use.
Triggered when the user successfully signs in.

conditions.description_zh: 检测用户是否已登录账号。
conditions.description_en: True if the user is currently signed in.

conditions.description_zh: 在 Google Play 游戏服务发生错误时触发。
conditions.description_en: Triggered if an error occurs in the game services.

conditions.description_zh: 执行 '请求玩家详细信息' 动作后，成功接收到数据时触发。
conditions.description_en: Triggered after 'Request player details', when the response has been received.
Triggered when the user signs out.

conditions.description_zh: 如果用户无法自动登录，则在启动时触发失败。需要使用 '登录' 动作。
conditions.description_en: Triggered on startup if the user could not be automatically logged in. It will be necessary to use the 'Sign in' action.

conditions.description_zh: 在用户没有登录Google时触发 有可能是因为用户取消或错误
conditions.description_en: Triggered when the user did not sign in. This might be because the user cancelled or due to an error.

conditions.description_zh: 执行 '提交分数' 动作后，提交成功时触发。
conditions.description_en: Triggered after a 'Submit score' action if the score was submitted successfully.

conditions.description_zh: 执行 '提交分数' 动作后，提交失败时触发。
conditions.description_en: Triggered after a 'Submit score' action if the score failed to submitted successfully.

conditions.description_zh: 执行 '请求最高得分' 动作后，请求成功时触发。
conditions.description_en: Triggered after a 'Request hi-scores' action if the scores were received successfully.

conditions.description_zh: 执行 '请求最高得分' 动作后，请求失败时触发。
conditions.description_en: Triggered after a 'Request hi-scores' action if the request failed.

actions.description_zh: 请求当前玩家的成就列表。
actions.description_en: Request a list of achievements for the current player.
actions.display_zh: 获取{0}成就列表 (强制重新加载: {1})
actions.display_en: Request list of {0} achievements. Force reload: {1}

params.desc_zh: 要请求的成就类型。
params.desc_en: Which achievements to request a list of.

params.desc_zh: 确保数据是最新的，而不是来自本地缓存的数据。
params.desc_en: Ensure that the results are up to date, and not from the cache.

actions.description_zh: 请求成就元数据（名称，描述等），允许相应的表达式返回正确的值。
actions.description_en: Request achievements metadata (name, description etc.) allowing the corresponding expressions to return the correct values.
actions.display_zh: 请求成就列表元数据。强制重新加载: {0}

params.desc_zh: 确保数据是最新的，而不是之前来自本地缓存的数据。
params.desc_en: Ensure that the results are up to date, and not from the cache.

params.desc_zh: 要揭秘的成就ID。揭秘表示玩家可知道该成就，但尚未解锁。

actions.description_zh: 解锁成就。玩家在离线状态仍然可以解锁成就，下次联网时通过 Google Play 更新解锁状态。

params.desc_zh: 要达成的成就ID。

actions.description_zh: 增加分步成就的达成阶段。
actions.description_en: Add steps to an incremental achievement.
actions.display_zh: 增加成就 [b]{0}[/b] 达成 [i]{1}[/i] 阶段

params.desc_zh: 要增加步数的成就ID
增加分布成就的步数。
params.desc_en: Number of steps to increment the achievement by.

actions.description_zh: 设置增加成就的步骤进度。
actions.description_en: Set the steps progress of an incremental achievement.
actions.display_zh: 设置成就 [b]{0}[/b] 达成阶段 [i]{1}[/i]

params.desc_zh: 要增加的成就ID
设置成就进度的步骤数。 这些步骤无法减少。
params.desc_en: Number of steps to set the achievement progress to. The steps cannot be reduced.

actions.description_zh: 显示 Google Play 原生成就对话框。
actions.description_en: Display the native google play games dialog for all achievements (only works in Android app).

actions.description_zh: 玩家登录账户后，需要通过此动作请求玩家的详细信息。
actions.description_en: If signed in, request the details of the signed in player.
Request the player to sign in.

actions.description_zh: 注销登录，如果用户已经登录。注意：Android 应用程序不支持此功能。
actions.description_en: Sign out if already signed in. NOTE: not supported in Android apps.

actions.description_zh: 提交分数到排行榜。如果分数低于榜单分数，则会被忽略。
actions.description_en: Submit a score to a leaderboard.
actions.display_zh: 提交分数到排行榜 (分数:  [b]{1}[/b], 排行榜ID: [i]{0}[/i], 标签: [i]{2}[/i])

params.desc_zh: 要提交分数的排行榜ID。
params.desc_en: Leaderboard ID to submit the score to.

params.desc_zh: 提交到排行榜的分数。如果分数低于排行榜的分数，则会被忽略。
params.desc_en: The score to submit to the leaderboard.

params.desc_zh: 用于后台备注此分数的额外信息，与分数一起提交，最多支持 64 个字符。
params.desc_en: Up to 64 extra characters to submit along with this score.

actions.description_zh: 从排行榜请求分数列表。
actions.description_en: Request a list of scores from a leaderboard.
actions.display_en: Request {1} {2} hi-scores from [b]{0}[/b] ([i]{3}[/i] results, [i]{4}[/i]). Force reload: {5}

params.desc_zh: 用于请求分数的排行榜ID。
params.desc_en: Leaderboard ID to request scores from.

params.desc_zh: 要获取分数的范围。获取所有分数，或当前玩家有关的分数。
params.desc_en: Whether to return all scores, or scores relating to the current player.

params.desc_zh: 返回指定时间段的最高得分。
params.desc_en: Return the top scores in the given time span.

params.desc_zh: 要返回的分数数量，从 1 到 25
params.desc_en: The number of score results to return, from 1 to 25.

params.desc_zh: 最高得分的通知类型，用于展示不同的内容。横幅仅包含最高得分，弹窗可展示更多分数。
params.desc_en: Return the top scores, or a window of the scores around the current player's best score.

params.desc_zh: 确保数据是最新的，而不是之前来自本地缓存的数据。
params.desc_en: Ensure that the results are up to date, and not from the cache.

actions.name_zh: 显示本地排行榜对话框
actions.description_zh: 显示原生Google Play指定计分板
actions.description_en: Display the native google play games dialog for a specific leaderboard (only works in Android app).

params.desc_zh: 要显示的排行榜ID

actions.description_zh: 显示原生Google Play所有计分板
actions.description_en: Display the native google play games dialog for all leaderboards (only works in Android app).
